hooks.command: [ -f .claude/timonel.config.json ] || [ -f .claude-plugin/plugin.json ] || echo '[timonel] No existe .claude/timonel.config.json en este repo. Ejecuta /timonel:onboard para generarlo.'

mkdir -p .timonel 2>/dev/null && jq -r 'if (.tool_input.command // "") | test("gh issue (create|close|edit|comment)") then "[" + (now | strftime("%H:%M:%S")) + "][gh] " + ((.tool_input.command | split(" ") | .[0:3] | join(" ")) // "?") else empty end' 2>/dev/null >> .timonel/events.log || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f .claude-plugin/plugin.json ] && jq -e '.name=="timonel"' .claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])#[0-9]+' && exit 0; echo '[timonel] Bloqueado: todo commit en Harness.Timonel debe referenciar un issue (#N). Crea el issue (gh issue create o /timonel:draft) y cita su numero en el mensaje (TIM-ADR-0005).' >&2; exit 2
